verdict.rationale: A direct hands-on probe confirms a live, machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1.0 specification with 35 documented paths at smithery.ai/docs/openapi.json, which an agent could use to generate a client — squarely satisfying the story. Earlier probe attempts at guessed paths (openapi.json at root, swagger.json, etc.) 404'd, but the actual documented location succeeds. Missing for 10: first-party documentation explicitly announcing/linking the OpenAPI spec, and independent community confirmation of its use.
